code_improvements.title: Add React Query hooks for Tenant Service
code_improvements.description: Create React Query hooks for tenant management (getCurrent, getSubscription, getLicense, getStats, upgradePlan, cancelSubscription, getBillingPortalUrl). This enables tenant admin dashboards to use the same hooks pattern as other SDK services.
code_improvements.rationale: tenant.service.ts exists with 7 complete methods but has no corresponding React Query hooks. The hook pattern is mature in use-discount-codes.ts and use-organizations.ts. Query key factory pattern in query-keys.ts can be extended.
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Add tenant key factory to query-keys.ts (tenant: { all, current, subscription, license, stats }). 2. Create use-tenant.ts with hooks: useTenant(), useTenantSubscription(), useTenantLicense(), useTenantStats(), useUpgradePlan(), useCancelSubscription(), useBillingPortalUrl(). 3. Export from hooks/index.ts. Follow the existing hook pattern with staleTime for read operations.

code_improvements.title: Add React Query hooks for User Group Service
code_improvements.description: Create React Query hooks for user group management (getUserGroup, list user groups, create user group). Enables backoffice admin UIs to manage pricing user groups (U19, ADULT_ORG, OTHER) using the standard hooks pattern.
code_improvements.rationale: user-group.service.ts exports userGroupService and backofficeUserGroupsService with 4 methods total but no React Query hooks exist. Pattern is well-established in other CRUD services like use-seasons.ts and use-discount-codes.ts.
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Add userGroups key factory to query-keys.ts (userGroups: { all, lists, list, my }). 2. Create use-user-groups.ts with hooks: useUserGroups(), useMyUserGroup(), useCreateUserGroup(). 3. Include staleTime of 5 minutes (rarely changes). 4. Export from hooks/index.ts.

code_improvements.title: Add React Query hooks for Price Rules Service
code_improvements.description: Create React Query hooks for backoffice price rules management (getPriceRules, replacePriceRules, getListingRules, upsertListingRules). Enables admin UIs to manage listing-specific pricing without direct service calls.
code_improvements.rationale: price-rules.service.ts exports BackofficePriceRulesService with 4 methods but no hooks. The hooks pattern for backoffice admin CRUD is established in use-seasons.ts and use-rental-objects.ts.
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Add priceRules key factory to query-keys.ts with listing scoping. 2. Create use-price-rules.ts with hooks: usePriceRules(listingId), useReplacePriceRules(), useListingRules(listingId), useUpsertListingRules(). 3. Mutations should invalidate both priceRules and rentalObjects keys. 4. Export from hooks/index.ts.

code_improvements.title: Add User Settings and Booking Policy hooks
code_improvements.description: Extend settings hooks to cover user settings, booking policy, and branding. Currently only useTenantSettings and useUpdateTenantSettings exist in use-integrations.ts, but settings.service.ts has 9 methods including getUserSettings, updateUserSettings, getBookingPolicy, updateBookingPolicy, getBranding, updateBranding.
code_improvements.rationale: settings.service.ts has comprehensive methods for user preferences and booking configuration, but only tenant settings have hooks. The hook pattern from use-integrations.ts can be extended to cover all settings endpoints.
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Create dedicated use-settings.ts hook file. 2. Add hooks: useUserSettings(), useUpdateUserSettings(), useBookingPolicy(), useUpdateBookingPolicy(), useBranding(), useUpdateBranding(), useResetSettings(). 3. Extend query-keys.ts settings section with user/booking/branding keys. 4. Add optimistic updates to mutation hooks. 5. Export from hooks/index.ts.

code_improvements.title: Add Share Service and SDK hooks for shareable links
code_improvements.description: Create SDK service and React Query hooks for the share API (createShareLink, getShareData). The API exists at /api/share but has no SDK coverage. Enables listing and booking sharing functionality through the SDK-first architecture.
code_improvements.rationale: apps/api/src/modules/share/share.controller.ts exists with create and get endpoints but no corresponding SDK service or hooks. The service pattern from booking.service.ts and hooks pattern from use-discount-codes.ts can be replicated.
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Create share.service.ts with ShareService class extending BaseService. Methods: createShareLink(type, resourceId, expiresIn), getShareData(token). 2. Export from services/index.ts. 3. Add share key factory to query-keys.ts. 4. Create use-share.ts with hooks: useShareData(token), useCreateShareLink() with mutation. 5. Export from hooks/index.ts. Types: ShareData, CreateShareLinkDTO.
